factories.name: newFindCustomerStep
factories.description: Resolve one customer by exact primary email address or exact display name with a QuickBooks query, distinguishing one match, none, and several.

inputSchema.description: FindCustomerInput identifies a customer by exactly one of its primary email address or display name.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the customer's exact display name, which QuickBooks keeps unique.

emailAddress.description: EmailAddress is one bare address such as jane@example.com, matched against PrimaryEmailAddr. QuickBooks does not require email addresses to be unique, so several customers can match.

includesInactive.description: IncludesInactive also matches customers made inactive, which QuickBooks treats as deleted; false matches only active customers.

factories.name: newCreateCustomerStep
factories.description: Create one customer with a unique display name, email address, names, company, phone, and currency; every attempt of the Step sends the same QuickBooks requestid to request replay of an earlier result.

companyName.description: CompanyName is the customer's company, at most 100 characters.

currencyCode.description: CurrencyCode is the customer's ISO 4217 currency when the company uses multicurrency; blank uses the company's home currency. QuickBooks cannot change it later.

displayName.description: DisplayName is required and must be unique across QuickBooks customers, vendors, and employees; a name in use selects nameConflict.

emailAddress.description: EmailAddress is the primary email address, such as accounts@example.com; blank leaves it unset.

familyName.description: FamilyName is the contact's last name, at most 100 characters.

givenName.description: GivenName is the contact's first name, at most 100 characters.

phone.description: Phone is the primary phone number exactly as it should appear, at most 30 characters.

factories.name: newCreateInvoiceStep
factories.description: Create one invoice for a customer with exact decimal item lines, dates, an optional document number, and a billing email; every attempt sends the same QuickBooks requestid to request replay of an earlier result.

InvoiceLineInput.description: InvoiceLineInput is one item line of a new invoice.

amount.description: Amount is the line amount with at most two decimal places. Blank computes Quantity times UnitPrice exactly, rounded half away from zero to two places; both are then required.

description.description: Description is the line text, at most 4000 characters; blank uses the item's description.

itemId.description: ItemID is the product or service item's Id, which supplies the income account.

quantity.description: Quantity is the item quantity, up to five decimal places.

serviceDate.description: ServiceDate is the date of service, YYYY-MM-DD; blank leaves it unset.

taxCodeId.description: TaxCodeID is the line's tax code, such as TAX or NON in a US company; blank uses the item's.

unitPrice.description: UnitPrice is the unit price, up to five decimal places.

inputSchema.description: CreateInvoiceInput describes one new invoice. Amounts are exact Decimals in the customer's currency.

billEmail.description: BillEmail is the address sendInvoice uses by default; blank uses none.

currencyCode.description: CurrencyCode is the invoice's ISO 4217 currency, which must be the customer's; blank uses the customer's currency.

customerId.description: CustomerID is the invoiced customer's Id, such as from findCustomer or createCustomer.

customerMemo.description: CustomerMemo is the message shown to the customer on the invoice, at most 1000 characters.

docNumber.description: DocNumber is the invoice number, at most 21 characters without a backslash, such as an order ID, so listInvoices can search for it; blank lets QuickBooks assign the next number when the company numbers invoices automatically.

dueDate.description: DueDate is the payment due date, YYYY-MM-DD; blank applies the customer's or company's terms.

privateNote.description: PrivateNote is an internal memo, at most 4000 characters, such as the application's order ID.

txnDate.description: TxnDate is the invoice date, YYYY-MM-DD; blank uses today in the company's time zone.

factories.name: newGetInvoiceStep
factories.description: Read one invoice by Id with its lines, exact decimal total and balance, email status, and linked payments.

invoiceId.description: InvoiceID is the invoice's QuickBooks Id, such as 130.

factories.name: newListInvoicesStep
factories.description: List one bounded page of invoices, at most 100, filtered by customer, document number, open balance, invoice date, and last update, in a stable order with the next start position.

inputSchema.description: ListInvoicesInput filters one page of invoices. Every filter is optional, and filters combine with AND.

customerId.description: CustomerID keeps invoices of one customer, by Id.

docNumber.description: DocNumber keeps invoices whose invoice number equals this value.

isOpenOnly.description: IsOpenOnly keeps invoices whose Balance is above zero, that is, not fully paid.

maxResults.description: MaxResults is 1 to 100 invoices; zero uses DefaultInvoicesPerPage.

startPosition.description: StartPosition is the 1-based position of the first invoice to read, such as the previous page's NextStartPosition; zero reads from the first invoice.

txnDateFrom.description: TxnDateFrom keeps invoices dated on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

txnDateTo.description: TxnDateTo keeps invoices dated on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

updatedSince.description: UpdatedSince keeps invoices created or changed at or after this instant, to the second.

factories.name: newSendInvoiceStep
factories.description: Email one invoice to its billing address or a given address; every attempt sends the same QuickBooks requestid, though replay support on /send is unverified.

inputSchema.description: SendInvoiceInput identifies the invoice to email and, optionally, its recipient.

invoiceId.description: InvoiceID is the invoice's QuickBooks Id, such as 130.

sendTo.description: SendTo is the recipient address; QuickBooks also stores it as the invoice's BillEmail. Blank sends to the invoice's BillEmail, and QuickBooks rejects an invoice without one.

factories.name: newRecordPaymentStep
factories.description: Record one received payment of an exact decimal amount and apply it to an invoice; every attempt sends the same QuickBooks requestid to request replay of an earlier result.

inputSchema.description: RecordPaymentInput describes one received payment applied in full to one invoice.

amount.description: Amount is the exact amount received and applied to the invoice, with at most two decimal places, such as the invoice's Balance.

currencyCode.description: CurrencyCode is the payment's ISO 4217 currency, which must be the customer's; blank uses the customer's currency.

customerId.description: CustomerID is the paying customer's Id; it must be the invoice's customer.

depositAccountId.description: DepositAccountID is the bank or other current asset account's Id; blank deposits to QuickBooks's Undeposited Funds account.

invoiceId.description: InvoiceID is the paid invoice's Id.

paymentMethodId.description: PaymentMethodID is the payment method's Id, such as for Credit Card; blank leaves it unset.

paymentReferenceNumber.description: PaymentReferenceNumber is QuickBooks's PaymentRefNum, such as a check or charge number, at most 21 characters.

privateNote.description: PrivateNote is an internal memo, at most 4000 characters.

txnDate.description: TxnDate is the payment date, YYYY-MM-DD; blank uses today in the company's time zone.
